toolCall.name: post_status
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"We are experiencing elevated outbound HTTP errors affecting partner integrations due to DNS resolution failures from an upstream provider. Our team is investigating and working with the upstream DNS provider to resolve the issue."}

toolCall.name: page_oncall
toolCall.argsRaw: {"message":"Partner integrations are failing due to DNS SERVFAIL errors from upstream authoritative DNS (ns1.acme-dns.net) for acme-logistics.com. Restarting CoreDNS did not resolve the issue. Manual intervention or escalation to the DNS provider may be required."}

response.text:
Diagnosis:
- Outbound HTTP errors to partners are high (64%).
- partner-sync logs show repeated DNS resolution failures (EAI_AGAIN) for partners.acme-logistics.com.
- CoreDNS logs indicate SERVFAIL responses from the upstream authoritative DNS server (ns1.acme-dns.net) for the partner domain.
- The coredns_servfail_ratio metric is elevated, confirming persistent DNS issues.

Remediation steps taken:
1. Restarted the CoreDNS service to clear any local resolver issues—this did not resolve the SERVFAIL errors.
2. Posted a public status update to inform customers of the ongoing DNS-related outage affecting partner integrations.
3. Paged the on-call engineer, as the root cause appears to be with the upstream DNS provider (ns1.acme-dns.net), which may require escalation or manual intervention.

The issue is ongoing and requires further action with the upstream DNS provider.
